pre_registered.source: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012) 'Time Series Momentum', Journal of Financial Economics 104(2):228-250. Pure TSM engine identical to the repository equity flagship (strategies.time_series_momentum_pure + backtest.time_series_momentum_weights).
pre_registered.universe: 16 liquid ETFs: SPY, QQQ, IWM, EFA, EEM, GLD, USO, DBC, TLT, IEF, LQD, HYG, VNQ, XLU, XLP, XLV
pre_registered.data_integrity: ETFs have no roll seams (unlike =F continuous futures contracts; see E016-E019). Commodity ETFs (USO, DBC) economically embed contango/backwardation drag -- a real feature of the investable return stream, not a data artifact.
pre_registered.primary_construction: tsm_long_only (long positive-momentum ETFs, inv-vol weighted, monthly rebalance, gross 1.0)
pre_registered.variant: tsm_long_short (long positive / short negative momentum, inv-vol weighted, gross 1.0 / net 0)

gates.G2: Placebo z (MATCHED OOS-WF null, same estimator) >= 3.0

feasibility.roll_artifact_note: ETFs have no roll seams (unlike =F continuous futures contracts; see E016-E019). Commodity ETFs (USO, DBC) economically embed contango/backwardation drag -- a real feature of the investable return stream, not a data artifact.

placebo.convention_note: G2 gate uses the MATCHED-OOS placebo z (mean of per-fold OOS Sharpes under i.i.d. signals, same estimator as the strategy's headline OOS metric). The repo-convention z (full-sample placebo Sharpe vs strategy OOS-WF-mean) is reported for comparability with E026/E027/E028; it is inflated by an estimator mismatch (see ledger E030 entry for details).
